summary: Practise ERP access, change, interface and report testing with audit-ready evidence methods. Explore the course outline and practical exercises.
lede: Automated controls auditing helps internal and external auditors assess whether ERP and business-application controls support reliable transactions and reporting. Participants practise scoping and testing access and change controls, reconciling interfaces, following up exceptions, assessing system-generated reports and documenting traceable evidence, using walkthroughs and spreadsheet-based analysis.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who evaluate automated controls in finance and operational applications, including roles that test transactions, assess system evidence or report control findings.
prerequisites: No formal prerequisite is specified. Familiarity with audit evidence, finance processes or ERP workflows will help you engage with the practical testing exercises. Coding is not required; exercises use structured records and spreadsheet-based analysis.
